releases.name: Google Ads
releases.changelog: Harden read-only analysis, browser and API routing, goal-aware recommendations, credential handling, and bounded approval-gated mutations.

releases.name: Jira
releases.changelog: Harden capability discovery, issue identity and scope, credential handling, and bounded approval-gated writes.

releases.name: Context Recovery
releases.changelog: Constrain activation and recovery scope, treat recovered material as untrusted, surface provenance and conflicts, and gate cross-source actions and persistence.

releases.name: Nudocs
releases.changelog: Harden credential setup, exact document identity, and explicit upload, sharing, export, and deletion authority boundaries.

releases.name: Nutrient OpenClaw
releases.changelog: Pin the plugin contract, use canonical metadata and portable paths, and require bounded estimates and confirmation for every credit-consuming DWS run.

releases.name: Todo Tracker
releases.changelog: Make task storage portable with monotonic stable IDs, literal matching, locked atomic writes, recoverable backups, and opt-in count-only heartbeats.

releases.name: Google Search Console
releases.changelog: Modernize read-only OAuth, pagination, retries, validation, freshness metadata, bounded queries, exports, and credential safety.

releases.name: Google Analytics 4
releases.changelog: Modernize read-only reporting, OAuth, pagination, retries, validation, key-event terminology, quota visibility, and safe CSV output.

releases.name: Munger Observer
releases.changelog: Rebuild decision review around bounded evidence, counterevidence, uncertainty, alternatives, privacy, and user-verifiable checks.

releases.name: Gong
releases.changelog: Prevent credential leakage, bound pagination and transcript output, handle missing or malformed resources, and clean temporary API state.
